title: Kissed Peppery Brazilian Korean Pear Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew featuring Korean pear, this dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner, combining the warmth of Brazilian cuisine with the uniqueness of Korean ingredients, all while adhering to satvik-friendly principles by avoiding meat and focusing on wholesome, plant-based ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the diced Korean pear and cook for about 5 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
Add the Brazilian peppercorns, salt, and black pepper, and stir well to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the pear is tender.
In a small bowl, mix the agar agar powder with a little water to dissolve, then add it to the stew and continue to simmer for another 5 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the stew cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional Brazilian peppercorns if desired.
